question: According to the Census of India - 2011, which state has the lowest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India - 2011, **Haryana** has the lowest sex ratio among all Indian states.
 
• The sex ratio is defined as the number of females per 1,000 males.
 
• Haryana had a sex ratio of 879 females per 1,000 males in the 2011 Census.
 
• This low sex ratio is a significant social issue and reflects gender disparities in the state.
 
• Efforts have been made by both the state and central governments to address this imbalance through various schemes and awareness programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and provides comprehensive data on various demographic parameters including the sex ratio.
 
• The sex ratio is an important indicator of gender equality in a society.
 
• Several factors contribute to the low sex ratio in Haryana, including societal preferences for male children, female foeticide, and other forms of gender discrimination.
 
• To combat these issues, initiatives like 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' have been launched to promote the education and welfare of girl children.
 
• Improving the sex ratio requires a multifaceted approach involving education, legal measures, and changes in societal attitudes towards gender.
